_schema: Settings for the automated drafter (scripts/draft.mjs) and its daily workflow. Times are New York wall-clock. A slot is empty when no calendar post other than a rejected or held one sits on it. The drafter runs when an empty slot falls between lead_days and trigger_days from now, then fills every empty slot from lead_days out to horizon_days. auto_approve true means posts that pass every gate are queued as approved; Matthew can still hold any of them from the batch issue until it publishes.
blocked_links_why: Milestone Navigator is launch-held on attorney review; is-this-normal posts point to Communication Snapshot until it clears.
